import unittest

from tests.helpers import BOOKS, d, library


class Expiry(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_an_expired_member_cant_borrow(self):
        lib = library()
        lib.members["m1"].expires = d("2026-01-31")
        lib.lend(BOOKS[0].isbn, "m1", d("2026-01-31"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            lib.lend(BOOKS[1].isbn, "m1", d("2026-02-01"))
        self.assertEqual([m.id for m in lib.expired(d("2026-02-01"))], ["m1"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
